questions.title: Designing and evaluating a web-based appointment booking system for a dentist's practice. (Q25A-B, ITE 2024)
questions.stimulus:
A developer is tasked with creating a web-based application for a dentist’s practice. The application should manage patient data, including contacts, appointments and billing.

The appointment booking process involves:

-   Patients login to the dentist’s booking site using an email address and password.
    
-   They are presented with a list of available appointment times and they choose a suitable time.
    
-   Patients receive an email confirmation of their appointment.
    
-   Each morning the dentist receives a printout of their appointments for the day.

parts.prompt: Create a data flow diagram for the appointment booking process.

marking_criteria.criterion: Provides a substantially correct data flow diagram, with appropriate external entities, processes and data stores.
Provides a data flow diagram with appropriate external entities and data stores
Provides a data flow diagram with appropriate external entities OR data stores
Provides a modelling tool showing some understanding of the system
